name: Before We Fall
description:
About This Game

Before We Fall is a party-building roguelite autobattler set in a dungeon that grows unstable as you explore and fight. Choose your route, equip your heroes, and combine their abilities into a company capable of reaching the dungeon’s heart before everything comes down.

Build Your Company

Your heroes fight automatically. You shape their builds through gear, skills, and spells. Combine their strengths, build around the relics you find, and burn away an old ability when a better opportunity appears.

Victory takes smart strategy and making the most of what the dungeon gives you!

Select Your Curses

Power comes with consequences. Follow branching paths of dungeon curses to strengthen your company while changing the dangers ahead.

Take richer chests guarded by skeletons. Face reinforcement waves for greater damage. Push toward keystone curses that change the rules of entire fights. Build a party that can thrive in the dungeon you’ve made.

Make a "Questionable" Bargain

Morrow offers gifts with significant advantages and equally significant catches. Let a compass choose your route for greater rewards, or trade a place in your company for a very important rock.

Push Your Luck!

Every detour costs precious time. Another fight could strengthen your party. Another chest could complete your build. But will you have enough time left to defeat the floor’s guardian before the dungeon collapses? Only you can decide what’s worth the risk.

Know when to gather strength and when to press onward. Defeat bosses, unlock new possibilities, and return with a new company and another dangerous idea.
short_desc: Before We Fall is a roguelite autobattler where you combine skills, gear and dangerous bargains, choose your route, and push for one more reward before the dungeon collapses. Build a party powerful enough to survive the dungeon and its curse!
